headline: CBN, NNPC sign deal to strengthen oversight of oil revenues
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria and the Nigerian National Petroleum Company signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen oversight of oil and gas revenues. The deal also aims to improve foreign exchange management.
why: NNPC is Nigeria's state oil company, and oil revenues are a major source of government income and foreign currency. The central bank manages the naira and foreign reserves, so revenue oversight affects both.
